context:
Goal: a small fix after the last review round gets one short read (the fix check) and merges (your 203 a).
Problem (rule): rule roles-review-cap-three gives a change that edits a guard or check a net-value test after round 3. A fix that lands after that test edits the same guard again, and the rule does not say whether the test runs again.
Based on (read): lane review-fix-check, 07:58 CST.
Departs from: main (silent on a post-round-3 fix) — a: the fix check alone covers it; b: the net-value test runs again on the fix.

Meanwhile: the lane waits for your go (task 254); this answer shapes only one line of its record.
home: claude-settings rule roles-review-cap-three; lane review-fix-check record

lastAnswer.note: Answered by 232 a, the same question, which you typed in lane review-fix-check at 08:41 CST Nov 5. The lane files it in decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3.

options.gain: A fix merges after one short read.
options.how: The fix check confirms the fix matches the finding.
options.label: No: the fix check is enough
options.lose: A fix that opens a new safety hole is caught only if the fix check sees it.

options.gain: Every guard change is weighed for net safety at its final form.
options.how: The round-3 reviewer judges net value again on the fixed head.
options.label: Yes: judge net value again on the fixed head
options.lose: One more read per guard fix.

title: When a fix after the last review round edits a guard or a check, does it owe the net-value test again?
why: Recommended: a. It keeps your 203 a promise of one short read, and the fix check still reads the fix against its finding.
